summary: Iteration 211 - Nightly Recap + Concierge Most-Asked Topics tested. All backend APIs working (100% pass - 17/17 tests). Frontend Nightly Recap panel shows KPIs, YoY comparison, GPT-5.2 commentary, movements, and top room types. Concierge Inbox topics feature shows GPT-clustered guest questions with counts and percentages. Regression tests pass for morning-brief-btn, hk-route-btn, sustainability-btn, group-requests-btn.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/nightly-recap/{property_id}?yoy=true - Returns full recap with date, rooms_sold, total_rooms, occupancy_pct, revenue, adr, revpar, arrivals, departures, no_shows, walk_ins, cancellations, top_rooms[], yoy block, commentary, as_of - VERIFIED
GET /api/nightly-recap/{property_id}?date_str=YYYY-MM-DD - Recap specific date - VERIFIED
GET /api/nightly-recap/{property_id}?date_str=invalid - Returns 400 with proper error message - VERIFIED
GET /api/nightly-recap/{property_id}?yoy=false - Returns recap without YoY block (yoy=null) - VERIFIED
GET /api/concierge/admin/{property_id}/topics?days=30 - Returns GPT-5.2 clustered topics with count, samples, window_days, fallback - VERIFIED
Topics endpoint uses GPT-5.2 (fallback=false) when EMERGENT_LLM_KEY present - VERIFIED
Topics endpoint clamps days parameter to 7-90 range - VERIFIED
Frontend nightly-recap-btn menu item - VERIFIED
Frontend nightly-recap-panel with gradient header, date label - VERIFIED
Frontend recap-kpis (4 KPI tiles with delta arrows) - VERIFIED
Frontend recap-commentary (AI commentary card) - VERIFIED
Frontend recap-movements (5 movement tiles) - VERIFIED
Frontend recap-yoy (YoY comparison block with 4 rows) - VERIFIED
Frontend recap-date-picker and recap-refresh - VERIFIED
Frontend ci-topics section in Concierge Inbox - VERIFIED
Frontend ci-topics-load (Analyse with AI button) - VERIFIED
Frontend ci-topic-{i} bars with counts and percentages - VERIFIED
Regression: morning-brief-btn - VERIFIED
Regression: hk-route-btn - VERIFIED
Regression: sustainability-btn - VERIFIED
Regression: group-requests-btn - VERIFIED
seed_data_creation: None - used existing data. aldgate-flats has 21+ concierge questions seeded for topics clustering.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 211 adds two competitor gap features: (1) Nightly Recap at /api/nightly-recap/{property_id} - returns last night's KPIs (occ/rev/adr/revpar), movements (arrivals/departures/walk-ins/no-shows/cancellations), top room types, YoY comparison, and GPT-5.2 commentary. Frontend: nightly-recap-btn opens NightlyRecapPanel with gradient header, 4 KPI tiles, AI commentary, 5 movement tiles, YoY block. (2) Concierge Topics at /api/concierge/admin/{property_id}/topics - GPT-5.2 clusters guest questions into topics with counts. Frontend: ci-topics section in ConciergeInboxPanel with ci-topics-load button and ci-topic-{i} bars.
